snippet.title: Tabletop RPG « Goblin Dice And Cleave » – Trailer Concept
snippet.description:
A new indie game Goblin Dice And Cleave

Genre: Tabletop RPG

Key Mechanics:

• 🎲 Build your dice decks and roll magical dice
• ⚔️ Strategic turn-based combat system
•🛡️ Real-time action mechanics

Universe:
Inspired by a CyberDark Fantasy novel. Perfect for fans of XCOM 2 and Dark and Darker.
